facts.claim: Kay 宣布已预约死亡马监狱，想去了解 Deirdre Gregory 在狱中的最后一天。
facts.quote: she had booked an appointment at the Dead Horse Correctional Facility

facts.claim: Kay 让其余人留守并指派下属负责，叙述者独自担心在监狱碰上 Luke Fulton。
facts.quote: the possibility of running into Luke Fulton

facts.claim: 车上 Kay 说庆幸此前有机会与那位父亲谈过，并觉得他谈家人的方式很怪。
facts.quote: I’m glad we got a chance to talk to the father when we did

facts.claim: 望着红岩荒野，叙述者想起自己的童年与无处可依的孤独。
facts.quote: They were the sentinels of my childhood

facts.claim: 法医 Joe 电话告知死亡时间在受检前四到十二小时，即昨晚七点到凌晨三点。
facts.quote: Death occurred between four and twelve hours prior to examination

facts.claim: Joe 说死者胃里主要是未消化的汉堡薯条，还口服了大量芬太尼。
facts.quote: She had a burger and fries, mainly undigested

facts.claim: Joe 报告腹部一道只在正面、不绕一圈的勒痕，除此之外无外伤。
facts.quote: There’s a welt on her midsection
We had reached the Dead Horse Correctional Facility.

relations.rel: 警探与法医，电话听取尸检结果
relations.quote: Medical examiner, she mouthed to me

relations.rel: 警探与被采访的受害者父亲
relations.quote: we got a chance to talk to the father

relations.rel: 法医与死者，验尸认定其死于芬太尼导致的心衰或肺栓塞
relations.quote: she died of heart failure or a pulmonary embolism

relations.rel: Kay 不知道叙述者与这名狱警有私下接触
relations.quote: I hadn’t told Kay about speaking to one of the prison guards

relations.rel: 警探与下属警员，路过时点头、敬礼
relations.quote: Kay nodded at him as we passed, and he saluted her

relations.rel: 警探调查死者的狱中经历与最后一天

numbers.claim: 门外已有七辆新闻采访车，是此前的两倍多
numbers.quote: There were seven now, more than double what had been there before.

numbers.claim: 死亡发生在受检前四到十二小时之间
numbers.quote: Death occurred between four and twelve hours prior to examination

numbers.value: seven last night till three in the morning
numbers.claim: 换算成昨晚七点到凌晨三点的死亡窗口
numbers.quote: which means seven last night till three in the morning

numbers.claim: 多名证人证实死者昨晚十点半还活着
numbers.quote: the victim was alive at ten thirty last night

numbers.claim: 原本八小时的死亡窗口被砍掉一大截
numbers.quote: chop off a significant portion of this eight-hour window

numbers.claim: 调查可聚焦在十点半到三点之间
numbers.quote: we can focus on ten thirty to three

numbers.claim: 法医说要百分之百确定还需做完整尸检
通常非自愿束缚不会只有一处勒痕
法医找到腰部那一处勒痕
numbers.quote: I triple-checked, once I found the one around the waist

numbers.claim: 叙述者曾与监狱里的一名狱警说过话
numbers.quote: speaking to one of the prison guards at the facility

turning_point: 法医 Joe 来电报告腹部一道只在前面的勒痕——暗示死者可能曾被捆绑束缚，为“他杀”添上新证据，随后两人抵达死亡马监狱。
notes: Joe 对勒痕性质仍“on the fence”，未定自杀或他杀；叙述者把父亲的割裂解释为接纳性取向后的应对机制，但未写入 facts 以免超限；叙述者尚未向 Kay 坦白与狱警 Luke Fulton 的接触。
